name: Dress
source:
A girl the protagonist comes across at the abandoned research building. She claims to recognize them, grabs their hand, and pulls them to the building. When asked where she was taking them, she said that there they would find the "way to escape this world."

The protagonist goes along with her, mainly out of curiosity.
